messages:
zoe.tran: hey team, quick q — who owns Dedicated cluster access and escalation for customer Private deployments? I'm stuck on VPC setup for our eval environment.
alex.morales: hi Zoe — platform owns the Dedicated infra. ping luis_platform for access, and see the runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboarding :mechanical_arm:
priya_sre: +1. if this becomes an outage / P1 for a customer, open an incident and tag `eng-sre` and `private-deploy` in the ticket. oncall will triage.
sam_peopleops: also note access requests need the corporate access form filled (People Ops approval) before we can enable service accounts. link: https://redwood.internal/forms/access-request
luis_platform: I can take this — Zoe, what's your org + the workspace id? I need those to grant `dedicated/cluster-admin` for the dev slot.
zoe.tran: org=acme-pay, workspace=acme-pay-eval
luis_platform: got it. I'll start a `grantit` job now. If you want to run locally later, use:
```
grantit request --resource dedicated:acme-pay-eval --role cluster-admin --reason "onboard Zoe for eval"
```
should be auto-approved once People Ops approves the ticket. expect ~10-30m after approval.
zoe.tran: awesome, thx. will file the form now.
security-bot: NOTICE: Private deployments require customer data classification check and KMS keys attached. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policy/private-deploy-kms
luis_platform: @zoe.tran fyi — if KMS isn't set up we can attach a temp key for eval, but prod deploys require customer-managed key. I'll coordinate with security if needed.
zoe.tran: ok noted. quick Q on escalation: if the Dedicated cluster runs out of capacity for an active customer, who do we loop in first?
priya_sre: first loop in `eng-sre` oncall, then Platform Pager (Luis). If it's capacity vs. quota, platform will open scaling requests with infra.
alex.morales: and cc your CSM + support lead so customers get proactive comms.
sam_peopleops: Zoe — once you're through the access form, I'll add you to the `dedicated-devs` group so future grants are smoother.
zoe.tran: filing the form now. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
luis_platform: granting now, you'll get an email when `grantit` finishes. if you don't see it in 30m, ping me here.
zoe.tran: saw the email, access works. testing VPC connection now.
luis_platform: nice. tag me if any terraform bits fail. happy to pair.
zoe.tran: pairing would be great — can we do 11:15am PT? :smiley:
luis_platform: works for me. inviting you.
priya_sre: adding a note to the runbook for oncall escalation steps — thanks for the q, Zoe.
zoe.tran: thanks all!
